newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Bangladeshi man kidnapped, beaten in Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshi man kidnapped, beaten in Kuwait.

text.p: Kuwait's Interior Ministry said on Monday a Bangladeshi man had lodged a complaint after being kidnapped and beaten, apparently by members of an Islamist group.

Abu Taleb Hussein, 29, filed a complaint saying five men dressed in traditional Kuwaiti clothes kidnapped him and took him to a remote area where he was beaten, ministry spokesman Colonel Badr al-Saleh said.
Hussein also reported being robbed of 25 dinars ($82) in the incident, Saleh told Reuters.
Al-Rai al-Aam newspaper reported on Monday that several people had complained of being seized and tried for alleged offences and flogged by the group.
The organisation apparently monitored people to check if they drank alcohol or had illicit sexual relationships and most victims received 80 lashes each, the paper said.
Conservative Kuwait, which bans the sale of alcoholic drinks, is studying its legislation to ensure it complies with Islamic sharia law. ($1=0.3047 dinars)
